    @staticmethod
    def pager_pipe(text, cmd):
        ''' pipe text through a pager '''
        if 'LESS' not in os.environ:
            os.environ['LESS'] = CLI.LESS_OPTS
        try:
            cmd = subprocess.Popen(cmd, shell=True, stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=sys.stdout)
            cmd.communicate(input=to_bytes(text))
        except IOError:
            pass
        except KeyboardInterrupt:
            pass

    @classmethod
    def tty_ify(cls, text):

        t = cls._ITALIC.sub("`" + r"\1" + "'", text)    # I(word) => `word'
        t = cls._BOLD.sub("*" + r"\1" + "*", t)         # B(word) => *word*
        t = cls._MODULE.sub("[" + r"\1" + "]", t)       # M(word) => [word]
        t = cls._URL.sub(r"\1", t)                      # U(word) => word
        t = cls._CONST.sub("`" + r"\1" + "'", t)        # C(word) => `word'

        return t

    @classmethod
    def tty_ify(cls, text):
        """Render documentation macros for terminal output."""
        macros = re.compile(r'\b(?:[IBMUCRL]\([^()]*\)|HORIZONTALLINE)')

        def replace(match):
            token = match.group(0)
            if token == 'HORIZONTALLINE':
                return '\n-------------\n'
            name, arguments = token.split('(', 1)
            arguments = arguments[:-1]
            if name == 'L':
                text, url = arguments.split(',', 1)
                return "%s <%s>" % (text, url.strip())
            if name == 'R':
                return arguments.split(',', 1)[0]
            if name == 'I' or name == 'C':
                return "`%s'" % arguments
            if name == 'B':
                return "*%s*" % arguments
            if name == 'M':
                return "[%s]" % arguments
            return arguments

        return macros.sub(replace, text)

    def __init__(self, args):
